explication: This archived Stable Diffusion WebUI extension replaces selected target faces with a face from a user-supplied image. The main workflow runs through the WebUI script hooks into the swap engine, which checks target safety, detects faces, applies a selected model, and optionally restores or upscales the result. A separate API exposes image swapping and model listing. The README documents the WebUI workflow and safety behavior; sampled source shows the principal calls, but not every host callback detail.
